components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The main route into selected work or the next hiring action.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { min-height: 44px; background: var(--jb-broadway-blue, #2f6f89); color: #fff; border: 1px solid var(--jb-broadway-blue, #2f6f89); border-radius: 0.25rem; padding: 0.75rem 1rem; font-family: Karla, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 700; transition: background-color 160ms ease, border-color 160ms ease; } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: var(--jb-deep-green, #4e6f61); border-color: var(--jb-deep-green, #4e6f61); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--jb-yellow-ochre, #d1a23f); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Inverted Button
components.description: A secondary command over a dark photographic field.
components.css: .ds-button-inverted { min-height: 44px; background: #fff; color: var(--jb-graphite, #222b36); border: 1px solid #fff; border-radius: 0.25rem; padding: 0.75rem 1rem; font-family: Karla, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 700; transition: color 160ms ease, border-color 160ms ease; } .ds-button-inverted:hover { color: var(--jb-broadway-blue, #2f6f89); border-color: var(--jb-yellow-ochre, #d1a23f); } .ds-button-inverted:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--jb-yellow-ochre, #d1a23f); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: Compact status and visibility metadata that never impersonates clearance.
components.css: .ds-status-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; width: fit-content; border: 1px solid rgba(26, 35, 43, 0.2); border-radius: 999px; background: #fff; color: var(--jb-oil-ink, #1a232b); padding: 0.35rem 0.65rem; font-family: Oswald, Arial Narrow, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.055em; line-height: 1.1; text-transform: uppercase; }

components.name: Project Row
components.description: A bordered reading row joining one image or index with situation, contribution, and route.
components.html:

components.css: .ds-project-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(15rem, 0.38fr) minmax(0, 0.62fr); gap: 2rem; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(26, 35, 43, 0.16); color: var(--jb-oil-ink, #1a232b); font-family: Karla, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-project-image { min-height: 15rem; background: var(--jb-oil-paper, #f3f6f8); } .ds-project-row > div:last-child { padding: 2rem 0; } .ds-project-row h3 { margin: 0.75rem 0; font-family: Iowan Old Style, Baskerville, Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.875rem; line-height: 1.2; } .ds-project-row p { max-width: 56ch; line-height: 1.65; } .ds-project-row a { color: var(--jb-broadway-blue, #2f6f89); font-weight: 700; } .ds-label { color: var(--jb-broadway-blue, #2f6f89); font-family: Oswald, Arial Narrow, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.055em; text-transform: uppercase; } @media (max-width: 767px) { .ds-project-row { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 0; } }

components.name: Photo Caption
components.description: A factual caption and explicit credit beneath a stable photographic occurrence.
components.css: .ds-photo-caption { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto; gap: 0.75rem; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(26, 35, 43, 0.15); padding: 0.75rem 0; color: var(--jb-oil-ink, #1a232b); font-family: Karla, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.8rem; line-height: 1.5; } .ds-photo-caption span:last-child { color: rgba(26, 35, 43, 0.74); white-space: nowrap; } @media (max-width: 767px) { .ds-photo-caption { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } .ds-photo-caption span:last-child { white-space: normal; } }

narrative.overview:
The site is an inhabited working surface, not a showroom. Documentary photographs supply place, weather, bodies, materials, and the scale of collective action. Type and rules orient a stranger through the work while the Knowledge Wiki, citations, captions, and care limits keep the public argument answerable to evidence and people.

The first viewport should establish Jamie, the literal field of the work, and the role he is seeking. Deeper sections move between photographic presence and quietly structured records. The interface recedes when an image needs room and becomes more explicit when evidence, limits, or a next action must be read.
keyCharacteristics: Direct enough for a time-limited hiring reader.
Source-backed without turning the page into an archive browser.
Warm through human presence, not ornamental softness.

rules.name: The Status Is Not Authority Rule
rules.body: A semantic color may orient review; it never clears a claim, photograph, or release gate.

rules.name: The Photograph Gets a Job Rule
rules.body: An image must contribute presence, place, relation, process, contradiction, or material evidence. If it merely fills space, remove it.

rules.name: The Surface Before Shadow Rule
rules.body: Prefer a tonal change or full rule before a shadow. Never pair a decorative wide shadow with a one-pixel border.

rules.name: The Practical Corner Rule
rules.body: Shape communicates handle, label, or containment. No large rounded panels, floating capsules, or cards nested inside cards.

dos: Do let the first viewport establish Jamie, role fit, and the actual field of work.
Do alternate photographic presence with quiet, highly scannable evidence.
Do keep captions factual, credits explicit, and interpretation bounded.
Do show collective activity without using collaborators as background proof of Jamie's importance.
Do preserve strong visible focus, semantic structure, stable image dimensions, and reduced-motion behavior.
Do let protected absence remain an intentional editorial result.
donts: Don't make the site feel like a generic SaaS landing page, private archive browser, consultant hype funnel, or decorative AI template.
Don't use an unapproved photograph, crop, caption, credit, name, metric, or collective outcome to close a persuasive gap.
Don't use thick side-rule callouts, gradient text, glassmorphism, decorative grids, giant metrics, or repeated identical card sections.
Don't over-round working surfaces or place cards inside cards.
Don't treat a strong image, oral history, green evaluation, or merged pull request as automatic publication authority.
Don't let citations overwhelm the stranger's primary reading path.
